paragraphs.text: The Pontotoc Farmers Market will open on its regular Saturday morning after Thanksgiving. The Nov. 28 market runs from 8 a.m. to noon at 25 W. Jefferson St. in downtown Pontotoc, according to the market flyer shared Tuesday by the Town of Ecru.

Shoppers can find the market one block off Court Square, behind First Choice Bank. The market also lists a site on Main Street in Ecru, but the holiday-weekend flyer directs visitors to the Jefferson Street location in Pontotoc.

The announcement highlights local produce, food and gifts. The market says growers bring produce from within 40 miles and that much of it is harvested in Pontotoc. Its food producers also draw on local farms for ingredients when available.
